title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode12 True Self

meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You came so close on this test, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I know...
I miscalculated on one problem.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I apologize for dashing your hopes.
I promise to be more careful next time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, it is a bit of a shame since you knew how to solve the problem.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You'll need to focus on your studies much more if you really do intend to become a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm going up to my room to review what I did wrong.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Okay. Keep doing your best, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I need to study...
I have to get a perfect score next time.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So that I can become a doctor...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's see... The problem I got wrong was...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(This cake doesn't taste like much to me.
Mom said it was good, though, so it must be.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(But it's not just the cake.
Everything tastes a little bland lately, even restaurant food and Mom's cooking.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wonder if I'm just overthinking this. Maybe I should do something I like to get my mind off things for a while.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Haha. How strange. I must just be tired from studying so much.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I still need to listen to that song everyone was telling me about yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: They said it's really bright and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: What exactly is a cheerful song?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: What was it I liked? What did I want to do again?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What are the things that I like...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: We're having beef stew for dinner tonight, Mafuyu. I know it's your favorite. Please have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, I will.
Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Mafuyu?
You don't look very excited.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, is it by chance not to your liking?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
N-No, nothing's wrong.
I was just thinking about something, is all.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, here's that book you lent me the other day. It was really interesting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's great! I had a feeling you'd like it, Mafuyu! Can you tell me what your favorite scene was?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
My favorite scene...?
I thought they were all very good, but...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (No matter what I do... No matter who I talk to, I keep feeling that something's wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's as if I'm talking about someone other than myself.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And the things I say that I like are really...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So, what does it mean to be me...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (How do I find out who the real me is...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this a fragment of a feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on her desire to find out who the real her is...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I've listened to a lot of different songs now, but they don't do what this one does...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (K's song has such a cold and dark tone to it, but I feel compelled by it for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why is it that only K's makes me feel this way...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: None of the other songs have had this effect on me, and I don't understand why...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I just don't know...
And there's no way for me to learn why.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even if I were to ask someone about this...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Would the person who wrote this song know...?)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I doubt I would've been able to do this without you. It encapsulates what I was hoping to express now thanks to you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I see...
I'm glad I could help.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What were you trying to express with this song?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes, you mentioned how this song needed to feel more stagnant. That may be the best way to look at this.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Not a harsh sense of despair, but something more silent and gradual...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (A SEKAI is ready to be born...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's so quiet, and there's no one else...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She wants to find... The real her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
This SEKAI is empty because she doesn't know who the real her is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She must be in so much pain...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know what I can do for her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'll try doing what I can.
